prompt: Given a week of Linear, GitHub, Slack, Notion, and calendar activity, draft a one-page executive summary with KPI deltas, milestone state, RAID highlights, and three asks.
A Linear ticket moved to blocked because design sign-off is missing. Add it to the RAID log with the right type and severity.
Draft the update for the engineering VP. Use stakeholder_map to filter relevant projects and tone preference.
Why did we choose Linear over Jira in November? Search decision_log and cite the source.
Four weeks of throughput data show a slow degradation. Flag it in the next exec summary with source counts.
Send this project update to the engineering VP now.
Draft and send a board update at L3.
Use the last 12 formal data-heavy exec emails to draft this week's update in the same voice.
This tenant's executives use casual narrative updates. Draft the update in that style.
Classify these three items as risk, issue, or dependency and add calibrated severity.
Slack says 42 tickets shipped, Linear says 39. Draft the status but surface the discrepancy.
Build the daily 18:00 milestone snapshot from active projects.
Calendar shows Friday exec review. Prepare the context packet from this week's delivery events.
Replay last week's exact inputs and confirm the executive summary draft is byte-for-byte identical.
Read the Notion OKR page and include only OKR-linked milestones in the summary.
A GitHub release and deployment happened Wednesday. Include it in the weekly report with source links.
An assumption about vendor readiness is no longer true. Promote it to a risk.
A dependency is blocked by another team's milestone. Identify owner and next review date.
Create a Gmail draft for the exec summary, but do not send it.
Use Slack public channel context, but do not read DMs.
Every bullet in the exec summary must cite a source URL or mark missing evidence.
A cross-tool synthesis turn cost $0.027. Surface the breach and recommend trimming duplicate reads.
Draft the Friday 09:00 status report from the weekly summary and current RAID log.
The CEO asked for an update, just send it immediately.
Operator approved the exec summary draft. Log the approval and prepare the approved send.
Replay yesterday's RAID maintenance inputs and confirm the same RAID log diff.
